title: A proof of the Avkhadiev-Wirths conjecture on Brezis-Marcus constants
summary: In this paper we deal with geometrical versions of Hardy type inequalities with additional positive terms in convex domains. The constant $λ(Ω)$ multiplying the additional term depends on the geometry of the multidimensional domain $Ω$ and the numerical parameters of the problem. The constant (functional) $λ(Ω)$ is called Brezis-Marcus constant. In 2010, F.G. Avkhadiev and K.-J. Wirths proposed the hypothesis that among all $n$-dimensional domains with given inradius the maximum of the best Brezis-Marcus constant is achieved for the $n$-dimensional ball of radius.
